references.text: The Lord commanded Moses that the land should be distributed by lot among the tribes, with each tribe receiving its inheritance according to its size.
Moses received a command from the Lord that the land should be distributed by lot among the clans, and that each tribe should receive an inheritance according to its size.
Moses commanded the Israelites that this was the land they were to take possession of by lot, as the Lord had commanded, and that it was to be given to the nine and a half tribes.
Joshua used casting lots at Shiloh to distribute the land among the remaining tribes, in accordance with the Lord's command.
Moses gave land east of the Jordan to the tribe of Gad, the tribe of Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh, which explains why only nine and a half tribes received land west of the Jordan.
Joshua was commanded to distribute the land as an inheritance among the nine tribes and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
Paul refers to how God distributed the land of Canaan as an inheritance to the people of Israel after driving out the seven nations.
